Name: The Farmer's Children Dialogue Tweaks
Author: lieutenantluckyk
Description:
Improved English dialogue for The Farmer's Children by xiddav. Most of the changes are to fix minor spelling/grammar mistakes, as well as altering some lines to feel more in line with the way vanilla characters speak.This was created primarily for my own save file and has not been extensively tested. Use at your own risk. 

[b]Installation
[/b]You will need to have The Farmer's Children by xiddav already installed, as well as all of its required mods. To replace the dialogue, simply merge the new folders with your Farmer's Children install, and choose "Replace All." Make sure that the dialogue and schedule dialogue JSON files for both the first and second child are replaced.
